title: El guapote
goal: Order fried fish and be told which one is worth it
culture: It comes whole, head and all, with fried plantain. Tajadas are the savoury green ones and maduro is the sweet ripe one, and that is the only real decision. Choosing your fish by pointing at the tray is normal.

beats.good: Guapote is the lake fish worth ordering. You met it on the fishmonger’s slab in the market; here it arrives on a plate.
Frito, whole, head and all. Al vapor exists on the sign and nobody has ever ordered it.
Tajadas are fried green plantain. Maduro is the sweet ripe one, and this is the fork in the road at every plate in the country.

beats.en: That one over there, the big one.
beats.good: El de allá — that one over there. Fish is chosen by pointing everywhere on earth and nobody minds you doing it here.
